evidence.note: translateLevel maps one ColorSupportLevel onto the implied stack: level 0 is ColorInfo false; levels 1, 2, and 3 set hasBasic, has256 iff level>=2, and has16m iff level>=3.
Browser constructors write only truecolor (level 3, all three flags) and basic (level 1, hasBasic only).

notes: Cardinality correction: the same struct's ColorSupportLevel is 0|1|2|3, so declared states are 4 levels times 8 flag tuples. Writers support only the three enabled implied stacks.

evidence.note: findMinimalFold writes exhausted with noMatch, ambiguous with match none, a unique some(match), or neither; it never sets ambiguous and exhausted together or pairs either flag with a conflicting payload.
bestAlignedMatch returns none on exhausted, then none on ambiguous, and only then reads minimalFold.match.
Both exhausted and ambiguous are written only with match none, so either flag implies an absent match.

notes: Member correction: match is Option<MatchedText>, not a boolean. UniqueMatchSearch has only ambiguous plus that option, so it is below the two-boolean net. MinimalFoldMatchSearch adds exhausted. Representable is 2 flags times none|some. Legal writes are exhausted/none, ambiguous/none, unique/some, and miss/none.
